enhanced.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed substantially.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

enhanced.name: Firefly
enhanced.description: Precision final blows with this weapon substantially increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby targets.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

enhanced.name: Headseeker
enhanced.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Desperado

enhanced.name: Desperado
enhanced.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire for an improved duration.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Closing Time

enhanced.name: Closing Time
enhanced.description: Further improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

enhanced.name: Paracausal Affinity
enhanced.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.
